## Session Summary

This was a multi-session general Q&A conversation (May 20–30, 2023) spanning many unrelated topics. No code was written, no files were created in the workspace, and no implementation work was done. The repo is empty apart from `.claude/` config. All value lives in the conversation itself — summarised below by session.

---

## Session-by-Session Recap

### 1. Thanksgiving Recipes (2023-05-20)
- User requested Thanksgiving dinner recipes; strong nostalgia for **grandma's cooking**.
- **Herb-Roasted Turkey Breast**: customised to grandma's style — heavy on **thyme & rosemary**, stuffed with **sautéed onions & carrots**, seasoned with salt, pepper, and paprika. Full updated recipe provided.
- **Creamy Mashed Potatoes**: basic recipe provided; follow-up discussion on switching to **Yukon Gold potatoes** (butterier flavour, fluffier texture, less liquid absorption).
- **Roasted Green Beans with Garlic and Lemon**: simple roasted side recipe provided.
- **Old-Fashioned Apple Pie**: full from-scratch recipe with homemade double crust, Granny Smith apples, cinnamon, nutmeg. Also inspired by grandma's version.

### 2. InDesign Cover Pre-Print Checklist (2023-05-23, 11:12)
- Created a 10-item checklist for InDesign cover tasks before a print run (document size, bleed, crop marks, CMYK, 300 dpi, font embedding, layer flattening, proofreading, PDF export, final PDF check).
- User requested it reformatted as a table (Korean: "표의 형태로 다시 만들어") — delivered.

### 3. Brief Greeting (2023-05-23, 11:31)
- User said "Hi!" — no substantive content.

### 4. Desktop GPU Upgrade (2023-05-25)
- Recommended mid-range GPUs: **GTX 1660 Super, GTX 1670, RX 5600 XT, RX 5700**.
- Compared power consumption (120W–225W TDP) and noise levels.
- Explained **GDDR6 vs HBM2** memory: bandwidth, power, cost, density trade-offs.
- Discussed factors affecting GPU pricing (die size, memory, cooling, manufacturing node, tariffs, demand).

### 5. Mechanical Keyboards (2023-05-25)
- Compared mechanical vs membrane keyboards (tactile feedback, durability, NKRO, customisability).
- Recommended gaming/everyday switches: **Cherry MX Red/Brown/Blue**, Kailh and Outemu alternatives, Romer-G, Topre.

### 6. Yosemite Camping Trip (2023-05-26)
- User is a **returning Yosemite visitor** — previously stayed at a **High Sierra Camp** for two nights.
- Provided packing checklist tailored to their experience level.
- Recommended day hikes: **Mist Trail to Vernal Fall** (user's pick), Lembert Dome, Sentinel Dome, Cathedral Peak, and others.
- Detailed prep advice for the Mist Trail: gear, what to expect, safety.
- Discussed shuttle bus schedule (typically 7:00 AM year-round).
- Advised **bear spray not essential** for Mist Trail (valley floor, well-traveled). User agreed — has prior bear experience from the **John Muir Trail**.

### 7. Professional Email Rephrasing (2023-05-28)
- Rephrased a message about **Oriental** seeking AI use cases and needing connection to the **AI Practice / Conversational AI COE**.
- Suggested email subject: *"Request for POC from AI Practice — Oriental's Inquiry"*.

### 8. Database Developer Interview Questions (2023-05-28)
- Provided ~20 potential hiring-manager questions for a **database developer** role (SQL optimisation, migration, replication, ETL, security, version control, stored procedures, etc.).

### 9. Private Sector & Poverty Reduction in Chaudhary (2023-05-29, 04:01)
- Discussed role of private businesses (Jaipur Rugs, Dabur, Mahindra & Mahindra, Bajaj Auto, ITC) in reducing poverty/unemployment in the Chaudhary region of India.
- Discussed government support: Make in India, Skill India, Startup India, PMGSY, Digital India.

### 10. WWII Naval Diorama Building (2023-05-29, 09:56)
- Centrepiece: **WWII-era aircraft carrier**.
- Covered scratch-building techniques for:
  - **Ocean waves/water effects** (resin, foam, fabric, texture mixtures)
  - **Harbor scenery** (buildings, docks from cardboard, foam board, balsa wood)
  - **Harbor lights/lamps** (glass beads, wire, LEDs, glow-in-the-dark paint)
  - **Antennas & radar** (wire, styrene, plastic rods, fiber optic strands)
  - **Deck crew & aircraft handling equipment** (toothpick figures, clay, wire chocks)
  - **Ordnance & fuel tanks** (styrene, aluminum foil, plastic bottle shapes)

### 11. Managing Too Many Hobbies (2023-05-29, 12:16)
- Advice for "Doug" on balancing hobbies: prioritise, set goals, take breaks, time-blocking, multitask, delegate, limit distractions, evaluate and narrow focus.

### 12. 5K Training Plan (2023-05-30)
- User runs with a **local club on Saturdays** (4–5 miles). Last 5K time: **31:15**. Goal: **sub-30 minutes**.
- Delivered a detailed **8-week training plan** (base building → speed development → endurance/strength → taper).
- Provided **lower-body & core strength exercises** (squats, lunges, deadlifts, planks, Russian twists, etc.).
- **Explosive power exercises** for weeks 5–6: box jumps, depth jumps, plyometric lunges, resistance band sprints, kettlebell swings.
- **Hill sprint** protocol: find a 30–90 sec hill, 3–5 sets, walk/jog recovery.
- **Yoga for runners**: Vinyasa/Hatha/Restorative styles, key poses (downward dog, warrior, pigeon, forward bends, plank), 1–2 times per week.
